title: Quality Analyst Reporting
description:
Everseen: A leader in vision AI solutions for the world’s leading retailers.
 
The Role
 
As a Quality Analyst Reporting, you will be responsible for monitoring, evaluating, and improving the quality of Reporting interactions to ensure a high level of operational excellence. You will work closely with Quality Analyst, Data & Reporting Managers, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and Operations teams to conduct quality audits, provide actionable feedback, identify improvement opportunities on evolving processes, tools, and ensure adherence to support processes, quality standards, and service level expectations. Act as a subject matter expert for quality processes, supporting audits, compliance reviews, and customer-facing quality initiatives. You will be responsible for creating Dashboards and reports of Quality checks. 

:

Key Responsibilities

1. Intelligent Risk-Based Auditing

• Targeted Sampling: Shift away from traditional random 10% sampling to design and execute a risk-based sampling model driven by historical error metrics.

• Efficiency Optimization: Focus expert auditing resources exclusively on high-probability error transactions (e.g., complex multi-item checkouts, tenured anomalies, or edge cases flagged by AI).

2. In-Line Guardrails & Feedback Loops

• Partner with the Technical Project Co-ordinator and Systems Engineering teams to design real-time feedback loops and automated validation gates directly within core auditing tools (GRIME and ASGARD).

• Stop data discrepancies at the entry point, ensuring errors are flagged and corrected  before  they exit the primary audit phase.

3. Data Quality & Root Cause Analysis (RCA)

• Systemic Issue Diagnostic: Conduct deep-dive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on recurring database discrepancies to isolate underlying drivers (e.g., software tool lag, vague annotation guidelines, or ML model classification gaps).

• Guideline Optimization: Translate RCA findings into immediate corrective actions, updated documentation playbooks, and training huddles for the reporting floor.

4. AI Model Guardrails & Collaboration

• Model Validation: Act as the authoritative validation layer for AI-driven engines, auditing and labeling the automated classification outputs to ensure a near-100% database gold standard.

• Mitigate Model Drift: Identify patterns where AI models begin to show bias or drift due to new cashier behaviors or store layouts, feeding structured corrections directly back to the Research and ML development teams.

Candidate Profile & Requirements:

• Experience: 3+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, or Data Quality Control within high-volume data processing, analytics, or tech operations environments.

• Analytical Toolset: Strong proficiency in data analysis, including statistical tracking, root cause analysis (RCA), and basic data tools (Excel, SQL, or dashboard reporting tools like BI).

• AI/ML Familiarity: Experience working alongside automated systems, data annotation platforms, or ML pre-labeling loops is highly preferred.

• Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive, "build-the-guardrail" attitude—someone who seeks to fix the process rather than just report the error.

• Communication: Exceptional collaborative skills, with the ability to bridge communication between front-line annotators, technical project coordinators, and ML engineers. 

• Education: Graduation in Engineering background

• Be our early-warning radar. Build smart, automated monitoring across revenue, spend, ROAS, and retention so the right people know what’s changing, quickly.

• Build the money models . Create and improve the LTV and ROAS models that guide our UA targets.

• Guide where the money goes. Help UA find where the next pound of spend works hardest across games and channels.

• Detect, diagnose, recommend. When something moves, find out why, put a number on it, and bring clear options.

• Prove what works. Help the whole team measure the real impact of their work, so we learn from every win.

• Level up creative testing. Help design how we test and pick winning ads, and the dashboards that track them.

• Tell the story. Share clear, simple insights with the team and leadership.

What You’ll Own::

Portfolio insight and commercial modelling. You’ll be the first to spot what’s changing across our games, put a number on it, and bring a clear recommendation; you’ll keep our LTV models fresh so every UA decision stands on solid ground.

How we’ll celebrate your success:
• How early we spot changes, and how useful the alerts are.

• Accuracy of LTV forecasts.

• Value of the recommendations the team acts on.

• How clearly we can see the impact of our work.

What We’re Looking For::
Essential
• Several years of analytics experience in mobile games or another app business with paid acquisition.

• Strong SQL and Python (or R); you enjoy building models, not just queries.

• Hands-on experience with LTV prediction, cohort analysis, and ROAS modelling.

• A solid grasp of experiment design and statistics.

• Commercial instinct: you talk in outcomes and recommend actions. 

• A clear communicator who makes data easy for everyone.

Desirable
• Experience building automated monitoring or anomaly detection is a big plus.

• Familiarity with mobile attribution and ad data.

title: Data Analyst
description:
About the role

Sebagai Data Analyst, Anda akan memainkan peran krusial dalam mengubah data kompleks menjadi wawasan bisnis yang actionable yang mendorong pengambilan keputusan strategis di seluruh organisasi. Posisi ini menuntut kemampuan analitik yang kuat, perhatian terhadap detail, dan keinginan untuk mengeksplorasi tren data yang bermakna. Anda akan bekerja dengan berbagai dataset dan alat analitik untuk mengidentifikasi peluang, mengoptimalkan proses, dan mendukung pertumbuhan bisnis. Jabatan ini merupakan posisi fulltime yang berbasis di Surabaya, Jawa Timur, memberikan Anda kesempatan untuk berkontribusi langsung pada kesuksesan perusahaan kami.
Key responsibilities

• Mengembangkan dan memelihara dashboard dan visualisasi data interaktif yang mengomunikasikan temuan kompleks dengan cara yang mudah dipahami.

• Berkolaborasi dengan departemen lain untuk memahami kebutuhan bisnis dan memberikan laporan serta rekomendasi yang relevan.

• Melakukan validasi data dan quality assurance untuk memastikan akurasi dan reliabilitas semua analisis.

• Mengoptimalkan proses data dan mengotomatisasi laporan rutin untuk meningkatkan efisiensi operasional.

• Mendokumentasikan metodologi analitik dan temuan untuk memastikan transparansi dan reproducibility.

• Menyajikan hasil analisis kepada stakeholder dan memberikan insights yang dapat ditindaklanjuti untuk mendukung strategi bisnis.

About you

• Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman sebagai Data Analyst atau posisi serupa di industri yang relevan.

• Pengalaman dengan Excel tingkat lanjut, termasuk pivot table, formula kompleks, dan data modeling.

• Kemampuan komunikasi yang excellent untuk menjelaskan insight teknis kepada stakeholder non-teknis.

• Keterampilan problem-solving yang kuat dengan kemampuan berpikir kritis dan kreativitas dalam mengidentifikasi solusi.

• Perhatian tinggi terhadap detail dan komitmen terhadap akurasi data.

Benefits
• Gaji yang kompetitif sesuai dengan pengalaman dan kualifikasi Anda.

• Paket asuransi kesehatan yang komprehensif untuk Anda dan keluarga.

• Tunjangan hari raya, bonus kinerja, dan insentif berdasarkan pencapaian target.

• Peluang pengembangan karier yang jelas dengan akses ke program pelatihan dan workshop.

• Lingkungan kerja yang kolaboratif dan mendukung inovasi serta pembelajaran berkelanjutan.

• Work-life balance yang sehat dengan jam kerja yang terstruktur dan cuti tahunan yang memadai.

• Kesempatan untuk bekerja dengan teknologi terkini dan tools analytics yang modern.

title: Sustainability Data Analyst (Senior Officer)
description:
About Earthworm
With most of our staff operating directly on the ground where the issues are, we work with our members and partners to make value chains an engine of prosperity for communities and ecosystems.
We see a world where forests are a boundless source of materials and a home for biodiversity; communities see their rights respected and have opportunities to develop; workers are seen as productive partners, and agriculture becomes the instrument to feed a hungry planet and keep our climate stable.
Yayasan Hutan Tropis was legally established in Indonesia in 2005 as a national non-profit organization (Yayasan). We are affiliated with the Earthworm Foundation as the implementing partner for activities in Indonesia. Our offices are based in Semarang and Jakarta, with a total of 73 staffs. Our operational areas include Aceh, North Sumatra, Riau, and East Kalimantan.
About the role
As a Sustainability Data Analyst (SO), your primary responsibilities are to:
• Provide guidance to other analysts in report delivery, insight generation and stakeholder engagement

• Demonstrate leadership in ensuring that our output is of high quality and delivered on time .

• Collect, clean and analyse information you receive from our clients to explain major trends and support the elaboration of recommendations guiding companies to transform their supply chains

• Summarize data insights in the shape of reports to provide a compelling story on the impact of deforestation on our customers’ supply chains, related to various agricultural commodities (e.g. palm oil, soy, cocoa)

• Collaborate with your colleagues in Malaysia, Indonesia, Ecuador, Ghana and Switzerland to complete the reports, and provide further data analysis as needed

• Stay on the lookout for ways to improve our internal processes and how we work together.

Your Profile
In this role, you’ll manage large, complex data sets, ensuring their integrity and quality while creating clear and compelling reports. Your expertise in Excel, including advanced skills in macros and VBA or Python, will be essential in automating and optimizing our data processes. Plus, your experience with tools like PowerPoint and Tableau will help you craft impactful presentations that tell a story.
You’ll also be responsible for leading specific workstreams, ensuring operational efficiency and continuous improvements in our processes. Your strong attention to detail will be crucial as you oversee the quality of reports produced by other analysts, providing final approval before delivery. Additionally, you’ll collaborate closely with the team lead/manager to align on timelines, templates, and overall report management.
We value a collaborative mindset and seek someone who can work independently while integrating seamlessly with our diverse, multicultural team. Your strong communication skills and diplomatic approach will help you build strong relationships and navigate difficult conversations with ease.
If you’re a curious problem-solver who thrives in a dynamic environment, enjoys mentoring teams, and is eager to contribute to our success, we’d love to have you on board. Let’s work together to create a more sustainable future!

Workings Conditions
Working conditions:
• Full-time position
• Fixed-term, 12 months contract
• Based in Jakarta, Indonesia
• Desk-based work, with travel to field sites in the Indo Pacific region when required
• Work from home when your line manager agrees, with reliable internet access
Joining Us
If you are in search of having a meaningful impact, with a desire to innovate and act for the environment, this offer is for you! The team you would join is truly committed to and passionate about finding concrete solutions to improve relationship between People and Nature.

About the role
The Market Intelligence Specialist gathers, analyzes, and translates market, customer, and competitive information into recommendations that support growth across Ergon Energy & Specialty Solutions (ESS). The role develops a clear view of market potential by region, product line, industry, and application, helping commercial and leadership teams identify opportunities, understand risks, and prioritize resources. Working within the Market Strategy and Communications team, the Specialist collaborates with sales, technical teams, operations, and business leaders globally.
Key responsibilities
• Develop and maintain a centralized market database covering market size, demand trends, customer segments, applications, and competitive positioning by country, region, and product line.

• Estimate market volumes and growth potential for ESS products, including HyGold, HyPrene, and HyVolt. Identify underserved markets and applications where ESS capabilities meet customer needs.

• Compare ESS sales and customer coverage with estimated market potential to identify gaps and help commercial teams prioritize opportunities.

• Track competitor products, capabilities, capacity changes, investments, partnerships, acquisitions, and regional market activity using reliable sources.

• Monitor industry trends, regulatory developments, supply and demand changes, emerging technologies, and substitute products that could affect ESS markets.

• Assess the implications of significant developments and provide timely updates explaining what changed, why it matters, and which opportunities or risks require attention.

• Work with regional commercial and technical teams to gather customer feedback, application requirements, purchasing drivers, and market observations.

• Combine customer insights with research to evaluate opportunities by market size, growth outlook, competitive intensity, customer requirements, and fit with ESS capabilities.

• Support product positioning, value proposition development, and assessments of new applications or market entry opportunities with clear analysis.

• Develop recurring market reports, dashboards, and concise briefings tailored to leadership, commercial, and technical audiences.

Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in business, economics, marketing, engineering, data analytics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

• At least 2 years of experience in market intelligence, market research, commercial analysis, business development analysis, or a related role.

• Strong Excel and presentation skills, including the ability to organize data, build analytical models, and communicate findings clearly.

• Experience with business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau is preferred.

• Ability to manage multiple research priorities independently and work effectively with colleagues across regions and time zones.

• Occasional travel may be required.

• Kolaborasi Lintas Tim: Bekerja sama dengan tim marketing (produk, channel, sales) maupun diluar tim marketing untuk memahami tantangan bisnis dan menyelesaikannya lewat pendekatan berbasis data.

• Evaluasi Metrik Bisnis: Memantau indikator pencapaian target business secara berkala dan memberikan "alarm dini" jika ada performa yang menurun atau mendeteksi peluang baru yang bisa dimanfaatkan

Minimum Qualifications

• Pendidikan min. S1 dari jurusan Statistika, Matematika, Sistem Informasi, Teknik Informatika, Data Science, atau bidang terkait.

• Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun sebagai Data Analyst, Business Intelligence, Data Insight, atau posisi sejenis.

• Mahir menggunakan SQL untuk pengolahan dan analisis data.

• Menguasai tools visualisasi data seperti Tableau, Power BI, atau Looker Studio.

• Analisis Statistik: Memahami dasar-dasar statistik (seperti uji hipotesis, regresi, dankorelasi) agar interpretasi data yang dihasilkan valid dan akurat, bukan sekadar tebakan.

• Data Wrangling: Kemampuan membersihkan data yang kotor/tidak terstruktur sebelum dianalisis

• Google Workspace dan Ms. Office Tools: Memahami ekosistem GWS, minimal Google Slides dan Google Sheets serta Microsoft Word dan formulasi rumus Excel

title: Head of Data
description:
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and strategic Head of Data to lead and scale our end-to-end data ecosystem. This role will oversee Data Strategy, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Analytics, and Data Governance.
You will play a critical role in enabling data-driven decision-making across our productive lending (SME/business loans) and consumer lending businesses. The role requires a strong combination of technical expertise, leadership capabilities, and business acumen to build a scalable, reliable, and compliant data function that drives business growth and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities
1. Data Strategy & Leadership
• Define and execute the company's data strategy and roadmap in alignment with business objectives.

• Build, lead, and develop a high-performing data team, including Data Engineers, BI Analysts, Data Analysts, and Data Scientists.

• Partner with senior leadership to drive strategic and data-driven decision-making.

2. Advanced Analytics & Data Science
• Lead the development of predictive and advanced analytics models, including credit risk scoring for consumer and SME lending, fraud detection, and collections and recovery optimization.

• Drive experimentation initiatives, including A/B testing and uplift modeling, to support product and business growth initiatives.

3. Business Intelligence & Analytics
• Oversee the development of dashboards and reporting frameworks across the organization.

• Deliver actionable insights on portfolio performance, including disbursement, PAR, and NPL, as well as customer acquisition, conversion, retention, segmentation, and behavior.

• Establish a source of truth and standardize business metrics across the organization.

4. Data Engineering & Architecture
• Lead and manage the company's data infrastructure, including data warehouses, data lakes, and data pipelines.

• Ensure data systems are scalable, reliable, secure, and efficient.

• Oversee data integration from core lending systems, payment and transaction systems, and third-party providers such as credit bureaus and e-KYC platforms.

• Enable real-time or near real-time data availability where required.

5. Data Governance & Compliance
• Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, policies, and standards.

• Ensure data practices comply with applicable financial services regulatory requirements.

• Implement data quality management, data lineage and documentation, and data access control and security standards.

6. Business Impact & Collaboration
• Translate complex data into actionable insights and business recommendations.

• Work closely with Risk, Product, Growth, Operations, and Collections teams.

• Drive measurable business impact through revenue growth, risk optimization, and operational efficiency.

Requirements
• Minimum 10 years of experience in Data, Analytics, Data Engineering, or Data Science.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a leadership role managing data teams.

• Previous experience in fintech, P2P lending, banking, or financial services.

• Strong understanding of both consumer lending and SME/productive lending businesses.

• Proven experience building and scaling data functions from scratch.

• Exposure to regulatory reporting and compliance within the financial services industry.

• Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations.

• Strong leadership, strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

• Ability to translate technical data concepts into business insights and actionable recommendations.

Technical Skills
• Advanced SQL skills and proficiency in Python.

• Experience with data warehouse platforms such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Amazon Redshift.

• Familiarity with ETL/ELT tools such as Airflow and dbt.

• Strong understanding of data pipeline design and orchestration.

• Experience with API integration and data ingestion.

• Proficiency in BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.

• Strong data visualization and storytelling capabilities.

• Knowledge of machine learning techniques, including regression, classification, and clustering.

• Understanding of credit risk modeling concepts, including Probability of Default (PD), Loss Given Default (LGD), and Exposure at Default (EAD).

• Experience with cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.

• Familiarity with big data technologies such as Spark is an advantage.

Why Join Us?
Be part of a growing financial technology business where data plays a central role in shaping business strategy, improving lending decisions, optimizing risk, and driving sustainable growth.

title: Data Intelligence Specialist
description:
Company Description

About Grab and Our Workplace

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Job Description

Get to Know the Team

The Data Intelligence team is the backbone of Grab's Business Growth Analyst organization, driving data accuracy, actionable insights, and strategic decision-making. We work with Sales Operations, Sales Compensation, and Sales Enablement to empower sales teams across all territories. Our mission is to ensure data-driven strategies that align with Grab's business objectives and fuel sustainable growth.

Get to Know the Role

As a Data Intelligence Specialist, you will analyze data to drive strategic initiatives, optimize sales processes, and boost operational efficiency. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, you will build and deliver dashboards, reports, and actionable insights to inform key business decisions. We seek a detail-oriented analyst who excels at translating complex data into effective strategies. This is a full-time, on-site role reporting to the Manager.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

•
Data Management & Dashboard Creation : Gather and organize data from multiple sources to build dashboards for churn monitoring, sales performance tracking, and market analysis.

•
Insights : Analyze sales trends, market dynamics, and performance metrics to deliver actionable insights that inform Go-To-Market strategies and sales programs.

•
Collaboration : Work with Business Growth Analysts, Sales Leads, and Key Account Managers to provide data-driven solutions and address on-ground challenges.

•
Monitor and Reporting : Monitor sales performance, campaign outcomes, and operational metrics, delivering regular reports to stakeholders for alignment and improvement.

Qualifications

What Essential Skills You Will Need

•
Education & Experience: Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, CS) with 3+ years of experience in data analysis or business intelligence. Experience in tech or sales operations is an added value.

•
Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL and BI tools (Tableau, Power BI) for building dashboards. Experience with Python or R is advantageous.

•
Analytical Skills: Ability to obtain actionable insights, and opportunities from complex datasets.

•
Collaboration & Communication: Ability to work with cross-functional stakeholders (e.g., Sales, Business Growth) and present strategic recommendations.

•
Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to ensure high levels of accuracy in all reports and analyses.

Additional Information

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

• We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.

• With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.

• Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave , and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave

• We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.

• Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: Product Analyst
description:
Tjitra & Associates adalah konsultan manajemen berbasis psikologi yang selama dua dekade telah mengembangkan lebih dari 1.000 pemimpin senior di 15 negara. Program unggulannya meraih EFMD Gold Award — penghargaan internasional untuk program pengembangan kepemimpinan, satu-satunya dari Indonesia. IWDemy (Insight Web Academy) adalah lini pembelajaran Tjitra yang memadukan metodologi, teknologi, dan kearifan lokal untuk membangun kapabilitas organisasi.
Bersama, Tjitra dan IWDemy mengembangkan tiga lini produk AI: pelatihan kepemimpinan AI untuk profesional (AI First TrainShop), advisory kesiapan organisasi menghadapi era AI (AI Readiness Transformation), dan aplikasi serta layanan AI (AI Solution Apps and Services). Posisi ini bekerja lintas ketiga lini — dengan porsi terbesar di AIF .

Product Analyst di I WDemy berdiri di tiga kaki. Pertama, BizDev: riset pasar, analisis kompetitor, dan menyiapkan materi untuk akuisisi klien korporat. Kedua, materi pembelajaran: membantu mengembangkan modul kursus, menulis konten, dan menyusun kurikulum bersama tim produk. Ketiga, marketing: merencanakan kampanye, menganalisis performa konten di berbagai platform, dan mengaitkan data tersebut dengan tujuan bisnis.
Kami mencari seseorang yang bisa berpikir analitis dan sekaligus mengeksekusi. Posisi ini bukan analis yang hanya membuat laporan — ini orang yang risetnya langsung menjadi proposal, analisisnya langsung menjadi keputusan konten, dan data yang dikumpulkannya langsung menggerakkan strategi.
Organisasi ini sedang membangun arsitektur AI terintegrasi — sistem operasi internal yang menghubungkan knowledge management, orkestrasi tugas, dan pengembangan produk dalam satu infrastruktur. Product Analyst di sini menggunakan AI sebagai bagian dari cara kerja sehari-hari — dari riset sampai produksi konten.

Tanggung jawab utama
• Melakukan riset pasar dan analisis kompetitor untuk mendukung akuisisi klien.

• Menyiapkan materi presentasi dan proposal program untuk prospek korporat.

• Membantu mengembangkan modul kursus dan konten pembelajaran bersama tim produk.

• Menganalisis performa konten di YouTube, Udemy, media sosial, dan sinau.tech.

• Merencanakan dan mengeksekusi kampanye marketing dengan data sebagai dasar keputusan.

• Mengaitkan temuan analisis dengan tujuan bisnis dan produk secara keseluruhan.

Persyaratan wajib
• Pendidikan minimal S1 dari universitas terkemuka, semua jurusan.

• Pengalaman minimal 2 tahun sebagai Product Analyst, Business Analyst, atau peran serupa.

• Memahami metrik dan analytics platform konten digital (YouTube, media sosial, MOOC, Udemy).

• Mampu melakukan analisis data kuantitatif dan kualitatif untuk riset pengguna. Mampu mengaitkan analisis data konten dengan tujuan bisnis dan produk.

• Menggunakan AI secara aktif dalam workflow kerja sehari-hari.

• Bahasa Indonesia aktif, Bahasa Inggris pasif.

Nilai tambah
• Pengalaman di industri edutech, digital media, atau creator economy.

• Pernah membuat dokumen riset kompetitor atau laporan analitik performa konten digital.

• Familiar dengan tools analitik dan visualisasi data.
